text:
Use ML to explore the data to answer your questions.

Now that you have decided what settings need to be used to guide the machine learning model, it is time to run your investigation.

Instructions

1) In the WaveRunner, choose the Station, Start date, End Date, and "compact model."

2) In the bottom control bar of the WaveRunner, click the "Run Model" button.

3) When the model is completed, click the “Timeline It!” button in the bottom control bar of the WaveRunner. Tip: Depending on your question, you may need to do steps 1 through 3 several times.

4) Answer questions 4-6.
